L&T Technology Services is hiring a Software Engineer & Tester to design, develop, test, and implement computer applications and systems. The role includes analyzing client requirements, customizing software, maintaining quality standards, and supporting project delivery.
Software Engineer and Tester developing applications and systems, testing feature performance and stability with Embedded C/C++

Responsibilities:
• Design, develop, test, and implement computer applications software, execute test cases, and test performance and stability of new features using Embedded C/C++, Python, Shell Scripting, GIT, JIRA, Jenkins
• Gather and analyze client business requirements and design and develop computer systems
• Oversee the installation of necessary software and customize software to clients’ unique requirements
• Ensure quality standards and procedures are maintained
• Work with team members to ensure delivery of project

Requirements:
• Bachelor's Degree (or foreign equivalent) in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, Electronics or Electrical Engineering or related field
• one year of IT experience
• one year of experience using Embedded C/C++, Python, Shell Scripting, GIT, JIRA, Jenkins
